displayType.description:
Indicates how the template parameter should be displayed in an UI. Possible values:
- "text" for text fields
- "list" for drop down lists
- "date" for date fields
- "no_display" when field should not be displayed

source.description: Source of the template parameter. Indicates how the field is populated. Can be a fixed value or a list of fixed values for a static variable, or a property of a business object for a dynamic variable. The Prefill parameters for the defined letter templates API should be used to return dynamic values.

sourceType.description:
Type of the source Possible values: 
- "date" when the source is a date
- "list" when the source is a list
- "collection" when the source is a collection and contains sub parameters (Note : list of parameters of the collection is currently not returned)

defined.description: Indicates if the template parameter is defined in the configuration (true) or not (false)

invalid.description: Indicates if the template parameter is invalid (true) or not (false)

editable.description: If true, the template parameter can be displayed as modifiable in an UI.

validation.description: Regular expression used to validate the value of the template parameter (ex : length), either in an UI or during Generate a letter API call

format.description: Format of the template parameter. Indicates how the value is formatted and will be displayed in an UI. Used for dates and amounts (ex : yyyy-mm-dd in case of date). Default format for date fields is dd/mm/yyyy

displayOrder.description: Display order of the template parameter

subParameters.description: List of sub parameters of the letter template

valueList.description: List of the parameters values which have been prefilled from business object data

subParameters.description: List of subparameters values associated to the letter parameter

next.description: URL pagination query parameter next page

parametersValues.description: List of the parameters used for letter template prefilling

parameters.description: List of the parameters related to the template, containing template parameter properties fetched from the LGS configuration file

description.description: Description of the letter template. Free text field

outputFormat.description:
Output format of the template to define the output format. Possible values are:
•	PDF
•	XML
•	WORD

structure.description: Used for Jasper letters. Defines the structure of the Jasper template

category.description:
Category of the template.Examples:
-	 CARD 
- DISPUTE 
- FRAUD

transformerType.description:
The transformer type defines the format of the template and so technologies that will be used to generate the letter. Possible values are:
•	JASPER
•	XSLT

responseDateTime.description: Timestamp when response date was generated

timeTakenMs.description: Wall clock time required from service to generate the response
